title: Useful app
body:
I love the simple of design, it’s a powerful habit tracker.
Strides provides a customizable and all-inclusive method of tracking habits, emphasizing SMART objectives and distinctive trackers. 
It offers comprehensive reports and templates, and allows you to track progress in a variety of ways.
It's not great right now; several functionality, including exporting API and supporting Markdown and links, are missing. FaceID is clumsy, and the theme seems a little dated. However, it accomplishes what every habit tracker software ought to.
author: Zalo Gan To

title: This app is a fraud
body: Dont buy their in-app purchase. I saw that they offer 7 day trials, so I chose to buy a life time premium with $90 with thinking that I will give it a try to see if it is worth the money. However, right after I pressed on the purchase button, they directly charge $90 from my bank account, without the trial period. I immediately requested refund from apple, but they said that Im not eligible cor the refund. I submitted for a review but still no hope. After checking the app, the UI is subpar and I have deleted the app from my phone. Just dont buy anything from this app
